title: Borscht Soup
description: A traditional Russian beet-based soup made with vegetables and served with a dollop of sour cream. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the onion and garlic over medium heat until softened.
Add the grated beets and carrots, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced tomato and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Pour in the soup broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the chopped dill and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of chopped crisp lettuce.
